root_cause_investigation_hint: scripts/check_branch_freshness.sh — investigate why local base was stale before rebase. Common cause: rebased against stale origin/main snapshot without git fetch first. Fix: use scripts/safe_push.sh which fetches + auto-rebases + pushes atomically.
closure_evidence: Same root cause and same repair as err-68454f9461dd, closed together because they are one staleness, recorded four times. All four name aria/pr-sweep-integration as the branch, but at least two of these pushes were of aria/substrate - the record captures the CHECKED-OUT branch rather than the pushed ref, which is a real attribution defect in the recorder and is noted rather than papered over. The staleness itself is resolved: the sweep branch reads 0 behind main and its final push carried no flags. On the substrate branch the freshness check is arguably the wrong gate entirely, since a pure-content branch carrying only letters and archive exports has nothing meaningful to be stale against, and rebasing it onto main would be churn with no reader.
